categories.main_business_segments: Changzhou Fusion New Material Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, production, and sales of new electronic pastes, primarily photovoltaic conductive pastes used in solar cells. The company also develops electronic materials for semiconductor, display, lighting, and other applications, including conductive adhesives and semiconductor materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced materials science and manufacturing technologies, including proprietary formulations of silver, silver-coated copper, and copper powders for conductive pastes. It employs precision printing and sintering technologies such as LECO laser-enhanced contact, ultra-narrow line printing, and low-temperature curing for perovskite tandem cells. The firm has developed a full-stack R&D system covering materials, processes, and equipment, enabling rapid iteration and adaptation to evolving photovoltaic cell technologies like TOPCon, HJT, X-BC, and perovskite.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading solar cell manufacturers including Tongwei Solar, Trina Solar, Jinko Solar, JA Solar, and others. The company serves the photovoltaic industry globally, providing critical materials for solar cell metallization. It also targets emerging markets in electronics, automotive electronics, 5G communication devices, and energy storage sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province. It has established overseas subsidiaries and production facilities in Japan, Thailand, Singapore, and other locations to serve global markets. Its products are recognized and used by customers in multiple countries, including emerging markets in the Middle East, India, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the photovoltaic supply chain, producing key raw materials such as electronic-grade silver powders and conductive pastes essential for solar cell manufacturing. It is expanding upstream into metal powder production and downstream into functional electronic materials and adhesives, aiming for vertical integration and enhanced supply chain control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment focused on next-generation photovoltaic metallization technologies, low-silver and silver-free conductive pastes, ultra-fine line printing, and perovskite tandem cell materials. The company emphasizes innovation in materials chemistry, process engineering, and equipment integration, while expanding into non-photovoltaic electronic materials and adhesives. It also invests in building a global footprint and enhancing customer service capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and distribution of photovoltaic conductive pastes and related electronic materials to solar cell manufacturers and electronic component producers. The company employs a combination of direct sales and dealer networks, with pricing influenced by raw material costs, especially silver prices. Additional income streams include investment income and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in photovoltaic conductive paste technology, holding a leading market position in China and internationally. It competes with other major photovoltaic material suppliers but has established competitive advantages through proprietary technologies, comprehensive product lines covering all mainstream solar cell types, and strong customer relationships with top-tier solar manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 12.49 billion, a 21.35% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 418 million. Despite a slight profit decline, adjusted net profit excluding non-recurring items grew by 2.52%. The company maintains a strong asset base of nearly RMB 8 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures reaching RMB 842 million (6.74% of revenue).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-performance, technologically advanced conductive pastes that significantly improve solar cell efficiency and reduce manufacturing costs. Its unique value lies in its full-spectrum metallization solutions compatible with cutting-edge photovoltaic technologies, proprietary low-silver and copper paste innovations, and integrated upstream raw material production. The firm emphasizes product quality, rapid iteration, and comprehensive customer support to maintain industry leadership and foster long-term partnerships.
